## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Lass dir Zeit damit.** — [lahs deer tsayt dah-MIT] — *Take your time with it.*
2. **Es liegt mir am Herzen.** — [ess leekt meer ahm HAIR-tsen] — *It's close to my heart.*
3. **Ich bin ganz bei dir.** — [ikh bin gahnts by deer] — *I'm fully with you / I completely agree.*
